title: relevance-guarantee-threshold
subject: Consultant and SME owner at a bright workshop table mark a clear damage-threshold line on a simple risk board: smaller risks below the line stay grey, one risk above the line is highlighted in cyan with an abstract euro figure.
context: Beraterium Relevanz-Garantie page section “Was relevant bedeutet” (DE) / “What relevant means” (EN). Visualises jointly agreed damage threshold in kick-off — not generic insurance, not alarmist. Professional B2B editorial for static website split column.

platform_website.aspect_ratio: 3:2 (split media beside text on guarantee subpage)
platform_website.optimized_variants_en: Convert PNG to WebP as img/garantie/relevanz-schwelle.webp for _gen_pages.py IMG_RELEVANZ_SCHWELLE
platform_website.best_practice_notes_en: Single readable focal point; threshold motif obvious at glance; calm office/workshop; works at ~480px column width and ~600px desktop split.
platform_website.safe_zone_en: Keep threshold board and hands in central 85%; avoid critical detail in outer 8% edges (rounded card crop).

composition.depth: foreground marker pen and corner of threshold chart, midground two people gesturing at board, soft blurred office background

lighting.style: soft natural window light with clean corporate falloff

style.mood: collaborative, clear, trustworthy — joint decision not sales pressure

optional_text_overlay.typography_en: No text on image — H2 and body copy render beside image.
optional_text_overlay.prompt_instruction_en: No readable text, numbers or logos on the board; abstract bars/lines only.

negative_prompt: no readable text or euro amounts on screen
no identifiable real persons or celebrities

seo.alt_text_de: Berater und Unternehmer legen im Kick-off die Schadensschwelle für relevante Risiken fest
seo.alt_text_en: Consultant and business owner agreeing the damage threshold for relevant risks in a kick-off workshop
seo.caption: Die Schadensschwelle wird gemeinsam im Kick-off festgelegt — darunter zählt ein Risiko nicht als relevant im Sinne der Garantie.

generation_prompt_single_block_en: Editorial photograph 1536x1024, 3:2. Modern SME workshop room, navy (#041E42) and cyan (#0B5FFF) accents with subtle teal (#0D9488). Two professionals (consultant + business owner, smart casual, diverse but non-identifiable) at clean table reviewing a simple vertical risk chart on a stand. Clear horizontal threshold line across chart: muted grey bars below, one bar above highlighted in cyan suggesting higher damage potential — abstract only, no readable numbers or text. Foreground: marker pen. Soft window light from left, medium contrast, collaborative calm mood. Clean editorial realism, medium-high detail. No text, watermarks, logos, alarm symbols, handshake clichés, distorted hands. Safe zone: subject central 85% width.
